queries.label: Sprint
queries.jql: sprint in openSprints() AND issuetype = Story ORDER BY rank ASC

queries.label: Mine
queries.jql: sprint in openSprints() AND issuetype = Story AND assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY rank ASC

queries.label: Blocked
queries.jql: sprint in openSprints() AND issuetype = Story AND status = Blocked ORDER BY rank ASC
